"''I was there. It's just asteroids and dust.|[[Akko]] and [[Han Solo]]|[[Age of Rebellion - Han Solo 1|''Age of Rebellion - Han Solo'' 1]]}} The '''Alderaanian Graveyard''',''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' known as the '''Graveyard of Alderaan''' to [[smuggler]]s,''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' was an [[asteroid field]] in the [[Alderaan system]] created by the [[Destruction of Alderaan|destruction]] of [[Alderaan]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire]], the graveyard was held under a [[blockade]] until the Empire's defeat at the [[Battle of Endor]]. After the battle the [[Alderaan Flotilla]] accessed the graveyard, looking for relics of Alderaan in the asteroids. The flotilla, carrying the survivors of Alderaan, was gifted the remains of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], to build a station in the graveyard. {{Loc-stub}} ==Appearances== *[[Age of Rebellion -
